name: Coco Nail Spa
subject: a redesign concept for Coco Nail Spa
custom_body:
Hi Coco Nail Spa team,

I am Ray, the founder of Vernon Tech and Media, and I build websites for small businesses here in Houston. I came across Coco Nail Spa and took a look at your website.

Your current site still carries a template from a few years back, and it is not really built for the phones most of your guests are booking from.

So I went ahead and put together a redesign concept to show what a modern version could look like. You can see it here:

https://vtm-demos.vercel.app/coco-nail-spa/

If you like the direction, just reply and we can talk about making it your real website.

Ray
Founder, Vernon Tech & Media
